body:
Really cool! That's a huge feature :)

In terms of API, I feel like the nesting isn't really natural (although it's more elegant in terms of code). Most of the time, we want to target multiple indices with no concept of hierarchy.

Here's something I had in mind, just for the sake of discussion!

```
<InstantSearch indexNames="['first', 'second', 'third']" defaultIndex="first">
   <Hits/>
   <Hits index="second"/>
<InstantSearch/>
```
